title: Nonnegativity of extended noise mass
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with $2\leq m:=|\Omega|$, and let $\rho\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $-1/(m-1)\leq\rho\leq1$. For all $x,y\in\Omega$, the extended noise mass at $(x,y)$ is nonnegative.
